svg.desc: Restoration and Rehabilitation of (ASU) Campus LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Ministry of Higher Education COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2018 175 million EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Restoration and Rehabilitation of Ain Shams University (ASU) Campus in Cairo. It consists of several clusters located in different areas in Cairo. Six of those clusters are located in Abbasia area, yet disconnected, having a total approximate area of 120 feddans. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management.
